items.item_text: 01. Do you have a High School diploma or GED? Options: Yes | No

02. Describe the coursework or training you have completed in music education, performance, theory, or a closely related field. Include the program or institution and the dates. If none, enter “None.”

03. Which best describes your availability? Positions may require availability for evening and weekend performances. (Select ONE) Options: I am available for the Mariachi schedule (8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.). | I am not available for any of these.

04. Music Assistant (Mariachi) - How many years of experience do you have performing in a mariachi ensemble? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year of experience | 1 year but less than 2 years of experience | 2 years but less than 3 years experience | 3 or more years of experience

05. Music Assistant (Mariachi) - Which mariachi instruments can you perform on? (Select ALL that apply) Options: Violin | Trumpet | Vihuela | Guitar | Guitarrón | Other | None | Not applying for Mariachi

06. Music Assistant (Mariachi) - Describe your mariachi performance experience and any experience assisting students or youth in rehearsals or instruction. In your response include the following: (a) Setting (b) Instrument(s) played (c) Your role and approximate dates. If none, enter “N/A."
Assists in music instruction and supervision of students during rehearsals, classes, and performances; performs alongside students to model musicianship and ensemble skills.
Assists in instructing students in instrumental music fundamentals across various ensembles and styles, such as marching band, jazz band, concert band, orchestra, and culturally specific traditions.
Assists in facilitating modern musicianship courses featuring contemporary instruments such as electric guitar, bass, piano, and drums.
Assists in preparing students for musical performances, competitions, and public events.
Conducts and supervises sectional rehearsals for small groups, demonstrating techniques through performance and playing with students to reinforce concepts.
Assists in planning, coordinating, and supervising musical performances and events; performs with student ensembles as needed.
Sets up, arranges, and breaks down rehearsal and performance spaces, including equipment, staging, and seating configurations.
Sets up, operates, and maintains sound systems, recording equipment, and other audio-visual technology for rehearsals and performances.
Maintains inventory of instruments, equipment, uniforms, and music library materials; tracks condition, location, and usage.
Performs minor instrument adjustments and maintenance; reports repair needs to appropriate personnel.
Maintains student records, attendance, schedules, and progress documentation as assigned.
Supervises student behavior and maintains discipline during music activities and events; models professional performance standards and conduct.
Collaborates with special education staff and related service providers to support student access, participation, and implementation of classroom and performance accommodations.
Transports equipment and travels to performance sites, festivals, and competitions as assigned; participates in performances with students at these events.
Perform related duties as assigned.
Music theory concepts, basic performance practices, and ensemble rehearsal techniques.
Cultural and stylistic characteristics of mariachi or other specialized music traditions, including common instruments and ensemble practices.
Principles of organizing and supporting school-based music programs, including budgeting, scheduling, equipment management, and event coordination
Techniques for supporting vocal and instrumental music instruction in group and sectional settings.
Basic choreography, staging, and production elements for musical performances.
Operation and basic troubleshooting of sound systems, microphones, recording devices, and related audio-visual equipment.
Methods for organizing and maintaining music libraries, instruments, equipment, uniforms, and supplies.
Basic record-keeping and data entry techniques for student, inventory, and scheduling information.
Safe practices in classroom, rehearsal, performance, and event environments.
Basic instructional methods, tutoring strategies, and student supervision techniques.
Perform instrumental parts alongside students during rehearsals and performances.
Demonstrate and reinforce music fundamentals, including rhythm, notation, and instrumentation, to individuals and small groups of students.
Adapt to various musical styles and ensemble settings, such as band, orchestra, mariachi, and modern musicianship.
Choreograph, stage, and assist in directing musical performances.
Plan, organize, and coordinate program activities, events, and logistics in support of rehearsals and performances.
Supervise and monitor students in classroom, rehearsal, and performance settings to maintain a safe and productive environment.
Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
Follow oral and written instructions, including those related to student support plans and accommodations.
Learn and apply school and district policies, procedures, and terminology related to music instruction and performance.
Model communications and interactions that respect and include all individuals and their languages, abilities, religions, and cultures.
Oral and written communication skills.
Set up, operate, and perform basic troubleshooting for sound systems, microphones, recording devices, and related equipment.
Communicate effectively with students, staff, parents, and community members both orally and in writing.
